recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. No additional core change is needed for FHIR-32976 unless OO later chooses different terminology for emergency-use authorization status or decides to model that status explicitly instead of as marketDistribution guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-32976 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 by OO. It requested marketDistribution with marketPeriod and subJurisdiction for DeviceDefinition UDI identifiers on both the model and packaging, and it specifically required comments clarifying that a device marked available on the market is fully authorized for distribution without EUA.
initial_application: The 2021 application commits substantially applied the structural part of the request: bf5e974e550ffec4b855db6376c97df2e028cb0c introduced the market availability backbone, e37cc34b4ef08a28de16dd759213c2f8748e32aa renamed it to marketDistribution and added packaging coverage, and ec664b4076c960b13429fbf4f7b37ea522d898d7 corrected marketDistribution to 0..*. Later same-family commits f8cefe81c5c2e493801523aa01875296c7e79243 and 2a3c31605e1f057f27252ba2e95f5846008f13bd applied FHIR-33950 child cardinalities and FHIR-34840 definition text. The current source still lacked the FHIR-32976 authorization/EUA clarification.
additional_context: DeviceDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/devicedefinition/structuredefinition-DeviceDefinition.xml is in current build scope. DeviceDefinition.packaging.udiDeviceIdentifier contentReferences #DeviceDefinition.udiDeviceIdentifier, so packaging inherits the same marketDistribution backbone. OO Confluence minutes from 2021-07-02 show market status wording still needed refinement after the proposed resolution, and 2021-09-10/2021-10-08 minutes confirm marketDistribution 0..* with FHIR-33950 as a complement. Related FHIR-32977, FHIR-33950, and FHIR-34840 are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published a source-changing commit adding an ElementDefinition comment to DeviceDefinition.udiDeviceIdentifier.marketDistribution: a device is only marked as available on the market when fully authorized for distribution without an Emergency Use Authorization (EUA). No duplicate packaging subtree edit was needed because packaging uses contentReference.
source_changes: source/devicedefinition/structuredefinition-DeviceDefinition.xml: added a comment to DeviceDefinition.udiDeviceIdentifier.marketDistribution clarifying full authorization without Emergency Use Authorization.

related_jiras.note: Complemented FHIR-32976 by mandating marketDistribution.marketPeriod and .subJurisdiction as 1..1; already audited on the combined branch.
Corrected the copied marketDistribution definition text without changing the missing FHIR-32976 EUA clarification; already audited on the combined branch.
Adjacent DeviceDefinition correctiveAction change applied alongside early FHIR-32976 commits but concerns a different backbone; already represented on the combined branch.
